messages:
maria-partnerships: Ok team — finalizing logistics for the joint webinar with VertexGrid on Apr 14. Quick checklist brainstorm here so ops + speakers are aligned.
jon-events: Thanks — main goals: tight live demo (10m), 15m panel, 5m rapid-fire q/a. Total 35m + 5m buffer. AV liaison: @sam-ops.
lee-marketing: We have 300 swag packs prepped (stickers + micro-notebook + co-branded mousepad). Can we confirm customs for EU attendees? :european_post_office:
ana-hw: Shipping manifest is ready. 250 packs to EU hub, 50 to US booth storage. Need customs docs from marketing for EU commercial name.
sam-ops: AV notes: remote speaker will need Webex + low-latency RTMP ingest. Onsite demo needs ethernet (not wifi) for demo laptops. I'll reserve 2 wired drops and a dedicated 500Mbps symmetric line.
tess-speaker: Re remote speaker flow — I’m presenting live from London. Do we have a dress rehearsal slot and a backup recorded clip in case of network issues?
maria-partnerships: Yes — rehearsal Wed Apr 12 10:00 PT. Please upload a 3-min pre-recorded demo to the shared drive as a fallback. Link: https://rwd.internal/shared/vertexgrid/webinar-fallback (permissions: viewer for all).
lee-marketing: Also need high-res logo (SVG), speaker headshots, and 1-line bios by EOD Mon. I’ll feed those into the registration landing page.
ana-hw: Demo logistics: VertexGrid will bring a prebuilt T4 edge appliance and a loaner laptop with our inference container. We should confirm container image tag and test vector set. Tag: vertexgrid/edge-demo:v2.1.
sam-ops: Important — create a local cached model snapshot on the demo laptop to avoid external pulls during the session. Command we’ll run in preflight: ```docker pull vertexgrid/edge-demo:v2.1 && docker save vertexgrid/edge-demo:v2.1 -o /tmp/edge-demo-v2.1.tar```
jon-events: Run-of-show draft: 0:00–0:02 host intro; 0:02–0:12 live demo; 0:12–0:27 panel w/ use-cases; 0:27–0:30 audience q/a; 0:30–0:35 closing + CTA to marketplace listing.
lee-marketing: CTA: link to cloud marketplace listing + trial credits. Make sure the landing page has a clear path: try -> docs -> contact. Also add a promo code for attendees.
maria-partnerships: For the marketplace CTA, partnership PM to confirm SKU name. @ana-hw is that the official listing name?
ana-hw: Confirmed: VertexGrid Edge Appliance — Redwood Inference Optimized. SKU: vg-edge-redwood-1.0. I’ll share vendor marketplace asset bundle by Tue.
tess-speaker: For live demo script: if the device stalls, switch to the pre-recorded clip then do a short Q/A and come back. Can someone own the fallback cut?
sam-ops: I’ll own it. I’ll run the pre-recorded clip via the OBS machine and signal host to transition. Need the MP4 by rehearsal.
maria-partnerships: Swag pickup ops: Tess, can you sign a waiver for international customs? We have a digital form here: https://rwd.internal/forms/swag-customs.
tess-speaker: Done — signed and submitted.
lee-marketing: Microsurvey for attendees after demo — 3 quick questions about latency, ease-of-use, and interest in POC. I’ll wire this into the post-webinar email.
ana-hw: Integrations checklist: we need to confirm that the VertexGrid appliance uses the Redwood runtime profile (quantized float16, KV cache enabled). Send the test prompts set so QA can validate perf numbers.
maria-partnerships: QA prompt set uploaded to the shared drive (folder: perf-prompts). Please run the 3 standard perf tests and post numbers in #eng-runtime.
jon-events: On the day: backstage Slack channel will be #webinar-vertexgrid-backstage. Everyone please enable notifications 30m prior. Host will ping 10m before go.
sam-ops: I made a short preflight checklist for T-60 / T-20 / T-5 mins. Copy: T-60: confirm network, device booted, fallback video present. T-20: mic check + camera. T-5: OBS scene ready, speaker muted until cue. I’ll paste the checklist in the channel.
devbot: Reminder: calendar invite auto-sent to participants with rehearsal link and Zoom + RTMP details.
maria-partnerships: Final note on recording rights: partner legal confirmed we can record and repurpose snippets for marketing. Please annotate timestamps of highlight clips during the session in the shared doc.
lee-marketing: Okay — I’ll coordinate highlight clip requests and the post-webinar asset pack (clips + slides + promo code).
tess-speaker: Thanks all — rehearsal Wed 10:00 PT. I’ll drop my slide deck by EOD Tue.
maria-partnerships: Perfect. If anything else pops up, add it here. Otherwise I’ll convert this into a short Ops checklist and pin it in #webinar-vertexgrid-backstage. :thumbsup:
